definitions.explanation: The muscles of the abdomen. Often used in fitness and health contexts.
Short for the exercise that works the abdominal muscles. Used colloquially to refer to the exercise itself.

examples.japanese: {腹筋|ふっきん}が{割|わ}れている{人|ひと}に{憧|あこが}れる。
examples.english: I admire people with defined abs.

examples.japanese: {水泳|すいえい}{選手|せんしゅ}は{腹筋|ふっきん}がとても{鍛|きた}えられている。
examples.english: Swimmers have very well-trained abdominal muscles.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}{腹筋|ふっきん}をする。
{腹筋|ふっきん}を{五十|ごじゅう}{回|かい}やった。
{寝|ね}る{前|まえ}に{腹筋|ふっきん}と{腕立|うでた}て{伏|ふ}せを{続|つづ}けたら、{体|からだ}が{引|ひ}き{締|し}まってきた。
examples.english: By doing sit-ups and push-ups before bed, my body has gotten more toned.

notes:
USAGE: {腹筋|ふっきん} has two common uses. As an anatomical term it refers to the abdominal muscles, and in everyday speech it often refers to the sit-up exercise itself.

The expression {腹筋|ふっきん}が{割|わ}れる (abs are split/divided) means to have a visible six-pack.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腹筋|ふっきん}を{鍛|きた}える: to train one's abs
- {腹筋|ふっきん}が{割|わ}れる: to have defined abs (six-pack)
- {腹筋|ふっきん}をする: to do sit-ups
- {腹筋|ふっきん}{運動|うんどう}: abdominal exercises
